mission.paragraph_1: The Paediatric Interest Group (PIG) is a student-led organisation dedicated to fostering interest and excellence in paediatric medicine among medical students. We bridge the gap between theoretical knowledge and clinical practice through hands-on training, educational workshops, and community outreach focused on child health.
mission.paragraph_2: PIG equips students with essential clinical skills, promotes patient-centred paediatric care, and creates opportunities for leadership, mentorship, and professional development; preparing students for clinical clerkships while making a meaningful impact in the community.

initiative_details.title: Membership Details
initiative_details.description: Register and pay a fee of $20 BDS (cash only) to any of the PIG board members. This covers your membership for one full academic year.
initiative_details.details: Membership is only open to students within the Faculty of Medical Sciences. See contact details for any queries.

initiative_details.title: A day in the life of a Paediatrician Programme
initiative_details.description:
Shadow a Paediatrician for a day and see what Paediatrics is really all about. 

Open to all paid members!
initiative_details.details:
As a PAID P.I.G. member, you’ll have the opportunity to step out of the lecture theatre and shadow a practising Paediatrician for the day! 

- Experience Paediatrics firsthand
- Observe real clinical practice
- Learn directly from a Paediatrician
- Gain early clinical exposure
- See whether Paediatrics could be the specialty for you!

hero.headline: The future of healthcare starts with compassion
hero.lead: The Paediatric Interest Group (P.I.G) is a student-led community at UWI Cave Hill. We strive to build clinical skills and heart for child health through hands-on training, workshops, and outreach initiatives that put children first.

upcoming_events.title: Immunization Schedule Seminar
upcoming_events.description:
Starting junior clerkship soon? 
Join us for an interactive seminar designed to help you confidently navigate the childhood immunization schedule and apply it in a clinical setting. 

More details coming soon, follow @pigcavehill for updates.

upcoming_events.title: Vital Signs Workshop
upcoming_events.description:
Think you know your vital signs? Paediatrics changes the rules! 

Join us for an interactive workshop where you’ll learn how to measure and interpret key vital signs, understand how normal ranges change with age, and recognize when a reading should raise concern.

More details coming soon, follow @pigcavehill for updates.
